title: Deep Mapping of Micro Water Bodies
description:
Deep Mapping of Micro Water Bodies is a Blue Digital Humanities project: an interactive 3D deep map of the historical, cultural, literary and environmental memories of India's micro water bodies, including ponds, kunds, tanks, canals and channels.

Each water body opens into four layers of memory: historical, cultural, literary and environmental. The website brings these layers together with photographs, soundscapes, a lexicon of Indian water words and citation tools.

Department of Humanities and Social Sciences, Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines) Dhanbad.
